statement: Giving anti-PD-1 before surgery, rather than only after, was associated with longer survival and with interferon and T cell changes in the tumour, in a small randomised study of recurrent glioblastoma.

measurement.assay: overall survival; tumour transcriptomics and T cell repertoire
measurement.effect: longer survival in the neoadjuvant arm

replication.note: One small randomised study; not confirmed in a larger trial.

limitations: survival difference in a small trial with correlative endpoints

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
